title: A Vector for the Archive
author: Astrid Sterling
blurb: Felix Amberdale, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
